_meta.serialization: JSON.stringify on raw JavaScript numbers; no display rounding
_meta.caseLineFormat: one JSON object per physical line inside cases[]

units.club: string compatibility label; does not select physics
units.spinAxis: degree; positive right curve for right-handed convention
units.curve: yard; positive right from launch line
units.smash: ratio; ballSpeed / clubSpeed, or 0 when clubSpeed is 0
units.launchLoftQuadratic: degree launch / degree dynamic loft squared

_meta.inputBoundaryBehavior: solveFlight does not clamp these five inputs; these are current UI and Guide bounds

edgeCaseSelection.adapterInDomainRule: signedVerticalSpinLoftDeg > 0; this rule is not returned by solveFlight

aerodynamicDiagnostics.reverseMagnusPolicy: not modeled; positive-lift bridge is extrapolated below Reynolds 70000

aeroModel.disclosure: Historical Pro-V1-class isotropic bridge; not exact current named-ball physics because proprietary modern coefficients are unavailable. Legacy-carry compatibility constraint for the curve flight only; not a ball property or named-ball calibration. Terminal RK4 lateral displacement is projected by its downrange ratio onto the retained Flightglass carry; this is a disclosed compatibility transform, not a measured ball coefficient.
